payload.summary: CME adoption contract still cites shared evidence for dark, forced-colours and print although CME-specific tests now exist
payload.detail: Narrowed on review 2026-09-25: tests/ui-cme-phone.spec.ts (13a1f2eee) now has CME-specific dark, forced-colours and print checks, but docs/design-system/adoption-contract.json still cites only the shared evidence files for the CME routes (now 12 CME routes, plus 15 On Call routes in the same group). Remaining: a manifest edit pointing at the CME captures, noting the forced-colours check covers /cme/setup only.
